limitations: Full semantic reading of all 7 lessons and all 81 complete question records; targeted primary-source verification and executable derivation checks, not a sentence-by-sentence source map.

All 28 lesson Python fences executed with required shared context; the split SkipList class fences were joined and the intentionally biased shuffle was checked as a counterexample. Non-Python algorithm sketches and every quiz snippet were not independently executed as separate programs.
Finite reference checks supply evidence, not formal proofs or performance benchmarks. Randomised asymptotic claims require the stated independence, capacity and arithmetic assumptions.

Vendor sources inspected for selected details; no Redis, RocksDB, Java concurrency, LMDB, Btrfs, genome-index or production cache deployment was executed. Redis implementation discussion is pinned to inspected 8.2 source.
Existing lesson/quiz URLs covered by root global link audit docs/audit-links.json. Link availability is distinct from claim verification.
